title: HyperCore perp position
description: One fund's HyperCore account trading one named perp market at a fixed cross leverage. Capital is USDC on eip155:999; how much to deposit and the size of each Ioc order are the strategy's decisions. Backtests and identified HyperEVM forks; production waits for D7.

capital.description: USDC on eip155:999 the fund starts with. It is not a limit.

leverage.description: The fixed cross leverage every entry needs, set while flat; at most the market's maximum.

slippage_bps.description: How far an Ioc order's limit lies from its reference price.

minimum_native_balance.description: HYPE the operator keeps for the gas of a fork run's custody transactions; below it, no new exposure. None by default; backtests exclude gas.
